## Problem

Describe the user, correctness, security, or maintainability problem this change addresses.

## Approach

Explain the implementation and important alternatives considered.

## Verification

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-features`
- [ ] `cargo doc --no-deps --all-features`
- [ ] Relevant false-positive, false-negative, malformed-input, or regression fixtures were added

Provide commands, results, benchmark artifacts, or evaluation evidence as appropriate.

## Security and privacy impact

Describe effects on detection coverage, offsets, normalization, overlap resolution, anonymization, pseudonymization, dependencies, untrusted input, failure behavior, or data handling.

Write `None` only when the change genuinely has no security or privacy implications.

## Compatibility

Describe public API, behavior, MSRV, feature, dependency, serialized-format, and migration impact.

## Prior art and third-party material

List related projects, specifications, algorithms, datasets, model artifacts, code, regex patterns, or documentation that influenced this contribution. Include licenses where applicable.

- Third-party material included:
